frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

native_facts: Horns575, paired grooved bone natural equipment on Head288/0. Native data does not specify skull coordinates.
authored_estimates: Ram-like curl, size, anterolateral crown root surface, root breadth and yaw are authored interpretation. Selected bare body/head is fixed.

south.attachment: Broad paired upper anterolateral crown roots at x344/424, y125, each approximately30px wide; root interiors sit on the skull above the ears, not alongside it.
south.direction: Bone initially leaves upward/outward, sweeps backward into a returning curl above the flesh ear; the same local curve is foreshortened in this view.
south.visibility: Both root transitions and upper curls visible. Horns above the head surface; original ears remain flesh below and are not included in the bone.
south.depth: Original body/head then near paired horns.

east.attachment: Same upper anterolateral crown surface, root510,143, approximately30px across; anterior to and above the original ear near474,211.
east.direction: Broad root rises from the crown, curves upward/backward toward screen-left, then returns above the ear. Full profile reveals the loop; the root is not on the occipital contour.
east.visibility: Near curl visible, far curl naturally hidden by the corresponding near curl/head in exact profile. Flesh ear remains independently visible below the curl.
east.depth: Far horn then original body/head then near horn; far and near project to the same profile silhouette.

north.attachment: Rear projection of the same paired upper anterolateral crown roots at344/424,141, approximately30px wide. Anterior root interiors are occluded by the original skull.
north.direction: Same physical curls seen from behind, symmetric around the skull. Their returning tips remain above rather than around the ear lobes.
north.visibility: Posterior outer curls and tips visible above/lateral to the head where not occluded. Preserve all original ears in front of the bone; no ear contour becomes a horn.
north.depth: Whole paired horns then original body/head, including original ears.

west.attachment: Mirror the east attachment for the symmetric paired natural Head288/0 item; do not shift the root to make both horns visible.
west.direction: Mirror the exact east projection, retaining skull-relative growth and return direction.
west.visibility: Mirrored near/far occlusion and flesh-ear separation; west acceptance depends on the east review.
west.depth: Mirror east anatomy only; item slot/laterality stays unchanged.

root_rendering: Continuous filled ribbon with no flat cap outline at the skull junction. Entire hidden bone remains in its independent item layer.
review_gate: Inspect manual and first refined drawings against each facing before extraction; point containment is diagnostic only.
